checks.name: quantifier index-domain divergence between declared F0 C0 and F2b D0
checks.w077_claim: Declared-F0 vs F2b quantifier-domain divergence. research_map/formulation_taxonomy.yaml @0abb9ed8a961 (revision 5), classes.AF-SCC-C0-VAC-GEN.conclusion.text (line 346) reads 'For every admissible (s,delta) there is a comeager set G_{s,delta} of data ...'. schemas/af_scc_c0_vacuum.yaml @55d0a1ea9bda (revision 12) defines quantifiers.domains.D0 (line 52) as 'a tagged disjoint union: r = smooth (the smooth-with-decay default) or r = (sobolev,s,delta) with s > 5/2 and delta in (1/2,1)' and quantifies 'forall r in D0' in quantifiers.formal (line 42) and conclusion.statement_formal (line 214). The declared F0 statement omits the smooth-with-decay branch that F2b treats as the default, so the two pinned artifacts state the same frozen class over different index domains. F2b f0_binding.declared_f0_sha256 equals the measured taxonomy hash, so the binding is hash-current but not index-consistent. F0 H3 ('the topology and weighted data spaces are owned by F2 and are unresolved here') makes this a dispositionable deferral, but the C0 conclusion text records no deferral and the lead's check_taxonomy_consistency.py compares taxonomy vs authoring supplement only, never the class-statement index domain, so its 'consistent: true' does not cover this axis.
checks.method: parse both YAML documents; test the F0 conclusion for an explicit smooth data-regularity branch and for an index-domain deferral; test F2b D0/formal for the tagged union and forall-r binder
checks.adjudication: The declared F0 C0 conclusion quantifies over admissible (s,delta) pairs only; F2b D0 is the tagged disjoint union {r=smooth} U {(sobolev,s,delta)} and binds forall r in D0. F0 H3 explicitly defers topology/weighted data spaces to F2, but the conclusion records no such deferral, so the two published statements of the same class carry different index domains. Dispositionable by one line: either restate the F0 conclusion over D0-as-owned-by-F2b, or record the H3 deferral explicitly in the conclusion.
checks.falsifier: show that the F0 conclusion text contains a smooth-data branch or a recorded index-domain deferral, or that F2b D0 does not include r=smooth; any one voids HF-01
